general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS ELEANOR HAYWOOD.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been this heavy, low mood for years, honestly, and I keep getting stuck on this fear that I’m going to end up like my father did… he died by suicide when I was twelve, and it sort of sits there in my head. I feel really down a lot of the time, and I don’t feel good about myself. But I’m not thinking about doing anything to myself.
current_concerns.goals: I just want to stop feeling like my father’s death is my future. And, I guess… break that pattern for my own daughter.

past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes, I had psychodynamic psychotherapy. It was… 2020 to 2022, I think, and there were about 60 sessions, in private practice.; 2020 to 2022.; About 60 sessions.

medications.current_medications: Medication 1: Name Or Description: Sertraline.; Dose: 100 mg each morning.; Start Or Duration: I started it in 2019.; Side Effects: No known side effects.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto… and my father died when I was 12. As a little kid, I was probably just… quiet, I guess. Well, and now I know I can be a bit serious, I’ve been told that for a long time.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I completed school and got a social work degree. I’ve always been pretty serious, I suppose. I don’t know if there was anything else especially notable.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married—it's been about 15 years, and it’s current. We have one child.
personal_history.future_goals: I want to break the pattern for my own daughter.
